task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from a full S3 URI path (e.g., 's3://my-bucket/folder/file.txt') and extract just the bucket name
solution_criteria: A regular expression that captures only the bucket name portion between 's3://' and the first forward slash, ignoring any paths or file names that follow

task: Convert an AWS CloudWatch log entry timestamp from Unix epoch milliseconds to a human-readable ISO 8601 format string
solution_criteria: A Python function that accepts a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds, converts it to seconds, and returns a formatted ISO 8601 datetime string in UTC timezone

task: Create a JSON configuration template for an AWS Lambda function that specifies runtime, timeout, memory allocation, and environment variables
solution_criteria: A valid JSON object containing required Lambda configuration fields including runtime (e.g., 'python3.11'), timeout in seconds, memory in MB, and an object for environment variables with at least one example variable
